headline: OpenAI Raises $11 Billion in Funding Round at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
summary: OpenAI has closed $11 billion in new funding as part of a round valuing the artificial intelligence company at $1.25 trillion.
why: OpenAI is a leading developer of artificial intelligence models, and its private valuation serves as a major benchmark for the broader technology sector and AI infrastructure investments.

impacts.name: OpenAI
impacts.why: Securing $11 billion in funding increases its capital reserves and sets a $1.25 trillion valuation.
